name: Benafarces (Spain)
description: Divided by a red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, yellow above and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Benafarces.
history: Municipal flag of Benafarces; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
Benafarces quartered arms — tower, cross and crescent, chequy and a tree
